excerpt: Git storage for the AI era
content_html:
Git storage for the AI era

On-demand Git for agents

Instantly spin up as many real repositories as you like when your agents need them. Create and delete them through a simple API in no time.

Free quota to try Pay as you grow

Create a repo when the agent starts. Delete it when it finishes:

Product

A Git storage engine you can build on

Solid foundation for your custom workflow UI, product, or AI agents. Amendable hosts the repos and API. You own the experience.

  1. 01

    Create repos on demand

    Provision private repositories through the API with access tokens scoped to what your agents or app need.

    Learn more in the docs (opens in a new tab)

  2. 02

    Push over real Git

    Clone and push with standard HTTPS Git. The Git password is an access token, not your account password. There is no SSH. Browse trees, blobs, and commits in a simple web UI when you need eyes on the code.

    Learn more in the docs (opens in a new tab)

  3. 03

    Wire events into your app

    Push and release webhooks hit your backend so you can run reviews, builds, CAD exports, or whatever your product does next.

    Learn more in the docs (opens in a new tab)

HTTP API + real Git

Manage repositories over a straightforward REST API, then read and write with ordinary Git clients. Agents and backends get durable repos without running Git servers.

Learn more in the docs (opens in a new tab)

API

Create and manage repos

Git

HTTPS clone and push

Tokens

Scoped access tokens

Browse UI

Inspect trees, files, and commit history in a simple web UI while you build the product experience your users see.

A backbone that stays up

What's the point of using Git as the backbone of your workflow if it keeps going down? Amendable is purpose-built Git storage for the AI era: a reliable backend you can build on.

Built for agents and CI that cannot wait

Repos reachable when general-purpose platforms are not

Your data stays yours

We do not train AI models on your repositories. You own your Content. Amendable stores Git so your product and agents can work, not so we can train on it.

No model training on your repos

You own your Content

Bring your own S3

Start on managed storage. Pro unlocks bring-your-own Amazon S3 when you need control over where objects live. Storage overage is discounted when objects live in your bucket.

Learn more in the docs (opens in a new tab)

OIDC for your machines

Grant CI, agents, and other machines access without planting long-lived tokens. Trust their OIDC identity and exchange it for a short-lived Git/API credential.

Learn more in the docs (opens in a new tab)

Start with on-demand Git

Free quota to explore. Pay as you go when you need more.
